_note: Reference only — NOT read by DemoSeeder. Footer/contact content (about text, link columns, social links, site name/phone/email/address) is already a real, existing feature: it lives in the `settings` table (key/label/content rows) and is seeded by database/seeders/SettingSeeder.php, which DatabaseSeeder already calls unconditionally for every environment. The four CMS pages linked from those footer links (about-us, return-conditions, privacy, cooperation) are seeded by PageSeeder. DemoSeeder does not touch either — duplicating them would just be a second, driftable copy of the same content. This file documents what already exists so it doesn't get reinvented.
